title: Cartwise+ Membership Terms: One Membership per Customer Profile
content:
**Clause.** A customer profile may hold only one Cartwise+ Membership that is not canceled — at most 1 per customer. A new enrollment is allowed only when every other membership of the customer is canceled. A person covered as a household member on someone else's Cartwise+ Family Annual or Cartwise+ Premier Annual membership who enrolls in a plan of their own must first be removed from that household, because benefits never stack across two memberships.

## Basis of the judgement

The judgement rests on the system's membership records for the customer's profile, read before the enrollment is made; what the customer says about other memberships does not replace those records. A membership counts against the limit when its status is any of: applied, trialing, active, past due, paused or pending cancellation. Only a canceled membership does not count.

## Status of the customer's other memberships

| Customer's other Cartwise+ memberships (hypothetical) | New enrollment allowed? |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| one, canceled | yes |
| two, both canceled | yes |
| one active | no |
| one pending cancellation (auto-renew off, paid period still running) | no |
| one paused | no |
| one past due | no |
| one canceled and one trialing | no |

## Points of judgement

- **Is a membership that has auto-renew turned off still a live membership?** Yes. Until the paid period ends and the membership is canceled, it is pending cancellation and counts against the one-membership limit.
- **Does household membership on another person's plan count?** A person covered as a household member who enrolls in a plan of their own must first be removed from that household; benefits never stack across two memberships.
